openItems.summary: BrainDriveAI is the owner organization and confirmed write-enabled administrator @DJJones66 is the initial CODEOWNER for all declared roles

Gateway and first-party MCP are internal beta same-release contracts; built-in provider profiles are beta-supported within declared configuration; custom MCP is experimental and none is a public SDK or generic compatibility promise

V1 Tauri J-05 claims native Windows and native macOS, each DEFERRED — REQUIRED BEFORE MILESTONE 7 until its sanitized exact-candidate report is integrated. Linux remains a configured bundle target but is not a claimed V1 J-05 platform. WSL/Linux is diagnostic-only. The prior WSL dynamic-gateway handoff failure remains a diagnostic record, not passing journey evidence

Vulnerabilities use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting and Security Advisories; restricted procedures use a BrainDriveAI-controlled private operations system administered by @DJJones66, with the exact locator kept out of public source

Canonical sanitized evidence is retained indefinitely; restricted release evidence is retained 36 months or 12 months past support in BrainDriveAI-controlled private storage administered by @DJJones66; configured GitHub settings evidence remains OPEN-08 work
Ordinary Vite development defaults to gateway port 8787; isolated Playwright allocates a gateway port and passes the exact VITE_GATEWAY_PROXY_TARGET to its task-owned Vite process
Both mode-100644 release helpers have a source-backed explicit Bash invocation; only --help was safely demonstrated, while production preflight and release execution remain restricted and unverified
CODEOWNERS source names confirmed @DJJones66; required review, branch/ruleset protection, stale approval, Documentation required-check, and retention settings evidence remains Step 7/9 GitHub work

PowerShell install/start/stop lifecycle scripts now adjudicate every native Docker exit before success output; the correction is source-tested in WSL, while controlled native Windows execution remains required platform evidence

The Playwright runner creates and removes disposable task-owned memory, secrets, auth, runtime, Vite, and artifact roots; it seeds a synthetic local account and credential-free usable shell, with passing desktop and mobile source-side runs
